notes.title: A game that will piss you off even more than the turtle!
notes.content:
A game that will piss you off even more than the turtle! Into the Sinkhole will be released soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/26451da54e6b8563747e4f8326677150312bc86a.png

A game you won't be able to go down even though you try hard!

A game that will bounce you up to the top even though you fall off all the time!

You NEED to equip some kind of "talent" for this game when you did NOT need anything for "Slow and Steady"

6pm on 16th of September(PDT), An anticipating platformer game "Into the Sinkhole" will be released.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/16d91a82863f42e02312f21af5823e2a61b34766.png

Into the Sinkhole is about exploring a mysterious sinkhole with an explore-bot "Laika". A number of artifacts were found and Laika was made for the exploration of it. As soon as the exploration started, some mysterious things were getting found in the Sinkhole. What kind of secrets would be hidden in the sinkhole? And would Laika be able to finish the exploration successfully?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40306648/5b90471eb4abc4475005e9e27902294fb4e1b341.png

If you like platformer games, you would definitely like this game too as we guarantee. We have prepared a detailed difficulty level structure and great operation sensitivity.

You are only able to play the demo until the game released so please be quick!

Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113180/Into_the_Sinkhole/


More Information!
https://twitter.com/creamgame_

YouTube!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCs4h4079Yxhtx4YuJfAgTTQ
